old.name: Burgundy by the glass on a tourist terrace
old.label: AVOID
old.hook: Place Carnot café terraces — the négoce's most anonymous cuvée at a markup
old.text: Place Carnot café terraces — the négoce's most anonymous cuvée at a markup The big café terraces pour the most generic regional Bourgogne by the glass at a tourist price, and call it the experience. The wine that explains the slope is tasted in a cellar, with someone who made or chose it — at Marché aux Vins , at Enstase , or on a négociant visit. Use the terrace for a coffee and the view, not for your impression of Burgundy.

avoid:Burgundy by the glass on a terrace.brief: Instead: Enstase, Caves Madeleine (table cards) or the Marché aux Vins (cellar card).

old.name: The frozen-snail tourist menu
old.label: AVOID
old.hook: The 'menu escargots' clustered around the Hôtel-Dieu
old.text: The 'menu escargots' clustered around the Hôtel-Dieu Several menus around the monuments sell frozen helix from elsewhere, drowned in industrial garlic butter, as 'escargots de Bourgogne'. True local Burgundy snails are scarce and seasonal. An honest bouchon — Ma Cuisine , Le Conty — will tell you straight which it is serving. Ask the question.

avoid:The frozen-snail menu.brief: Verify the claim honestly: most 'escargots de Bourgogne' served in France are Helix pomatia imported from Central/Eastern Europe, the snail being protected in France (picking regulated since 1979 — verify). Instead: Ma Cuisine or Le Bistrot Bourguignon (table cards) only if their records support escargots.

old.name: Arriving for a quiet day on auction Sunday
old.label: AVOID
old.hook: The third Sunday of November — the Vente des Vins
old.text: The third Sunday of November — the Vente des Vins If you want Beaune calm, do not come on the third Sunday of November. That is the Vente des Vins weekend — the town's loudest, with the auction in the Halles, projections on the monuments, crowds in every street. Magnificent, but the opposite of the quiet this guide is built around. Come for the auction deliberately, or avoid that weekend deliberately.

avoid:A quiet day on auction Sunday.brief: The auction weekend 13-16 Nov 2026 (the hot board and the calendar carry the dates: name only). Instead: come the week before, or on the Monday after.

old.name: Driving the Route des Grands Crus and tasting
old.label: AVOID
old.hook: Cellar visits, a car, and France's drink-drive limit
old.text: Cellar visits, a car, and France's drink-drive limit It is tempting to drive Pommard–Volnay–Meursault and taste at each. France's limit is low and the gendarmerie know the season. Either walk the vineyard route, hire a driver or a cycling tour, or appoint one taster who stays dry. The wine will keep; the licence might not.

avoid:Tasting and driving the Route.brief: France's limit 0.5 g/l (0.2 for new drivers) — verify. Instead: the walk to Meursault, a driver or a bike (verify a bike-hire in Beaune only if confident).

old.name: The cellar-and-counter night
old.label: LATE
old.hook: Beaune's evening is a glass and a conversation, not a dancefloor
old.text: Beaune's evening is a glass and a conversation, not a dancefloor An honest read: Beaune is a wine town of 22,000, not a club town. The night is the natural-wine counter at Enstase (which opens its concealed kitchen on Thursdays and Fridays for communal bao and gua bao under chef Pierre-Olivier Soares), a wine bar around Place Madeleine, a last glass with someone who can talk you through it. Treat that as the programme, not the shortfall. Where Place Madeleine · Enstase

old.name: Dijon — La Vapeur SMAC & Le SIRK Festival
old.label: ELECTRONIC
old.hook: La Vapeur (42 av. Stalingrad) · Le SIRK Festival every April
old.text: La Vapeur (42 av. Stalingrad) · Le SIRK Festival every April For an electronic night Beaune cannot give you, drive 45 minutes to Dijon. La Vapeur , the regional SMAC (600 cap., 42 Avenue de Stalingrad), runs the year-round programme — including the SYNC B2B nights showcasing Dijon's electronic collectives and the international L'Extra Festival (7–10 May 2026, lineups from Germany, Algeria, Belgium, Venezuela, Switzerland, Italy, Spain, Colombia, Brazil). The Le SIRK Festival , every April, is the region's major dedicated electronic event — techno, house, ambient, footwork — spread across La Vapeur, the Consortium contemporary-art museum (a Shigeru Ban building) and a former aerodrome. Past lineups: Ellen Allien, Steffi, SHERELLE. Where Dijon — 45 min north
